parameters.description: Interior front-to-back size in 42mm Gridfinity units

parameters.description: Interior top height in 7mm Gridfinity units

parameters.name: Gridfinity_Stackable
parameters.description: Add Gridfinity base stacking plates to outside of box top and bottom. Requires supports to print.

parameters.name: Lip_Seal_Type
parameters.description: Type or shape of seal to use, if desired

parameters.name: Reinforced_Corners
parameters.description: Make the corners as thick as the box lip

parameters.name: Top_Grip
parameters.description: Add a front grip to the box top (for boxes with two latches)

parameters.name: Hinge_End_Stops
parameters.description: Add end stops to the hinges on the box bottom

parameters.name: Stacking_Latches
parameters.description: Add stacking latches and attachment points to the sides of the box

parameters.name: Latch_Type
parameters.description: Latch style

parameters.name: Third_Hinge
parameters.description: Add a third hinge for boxes 5U or wider

parameters.name: Handle
parameters.description: Optional handle for sufficiently wide boxes

parameters.name: Label
parameters.description: Optional label for sufficiently wide boxes

parameters.name: Label_Text
parameters.description: Custom text for optional label

parameters.name: Label_Text_Size
parameters.description: Approximate height of text for optional label in millimeters

parameters.name: Wall_Thickness
parameters.description: Base wall thickness in millimeters for most of the box

parameters.name: Lip_Thickness
parameters.description: Thickness in millimeters to add to the wall thickness for the box lip

parameters.name: Rib_Width
parameters.description: Base thickness in millimeters of the support ribs. The latch ribs are this thick, while the hinge and side ribs are twice this thick.

parameters.name: Latch_Width
parameters.description: Latch width in millimeters

parameters.name: Latch_Screw_Separation
parameters.description: Distance in millimeters between the latch hinge and catch screws which determines the latch vertical size

parameters.name: Size_Tolerance
parameters.description: Width in millimeters subtracted from latches for fit
